luiskr.com / website/components/home/mosaic/burn/paper / rasterizeTitle

function rasterizeTitle(title, paper, cssW, cssH, ink): void

Defined in: website/components/home/mosaic/burn/paper.ts:130

Rasterizes the h2 text into the paper canvas. Words are drawn at their DOM Range fragment positions (see titleWordBoxes), so the raster is pixel-faithful to the rendered title — same wraps, same spacing. Engines without Range fall back to a measured word-pack matching the DOM box, drawn bottom-anchored like the overlay's align-items: flex-end.

cssW/cssH are the title box in CSS px while the paper's backing store is device px (cssW × dpr): canvas font and measureText units are CSS px, so the context is scaled cssW→paper.width first — without the transform the glyphs land at 1/dpr size on hidpi/fractional displays (the "burn text renders smaller than the title" bug).
